en.name: Physician
en.ability: Each night, choose two players (not yourself): they are sober, healthy & get true info tonight. The 1st time the Demon kills one, you learn the Demon type.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose two players (not yourself): they are sober, healthy & get true info tonight. The 1st time the Demon kills one, you learn the Demon type.

en.flavor: "Some patients recover, because they believe in doctors." - Hippocrates of Kos c. 460 B.C. - c. 370 B.C.
en.firstNightReminder: The Physician points to two players not themselves. Mark both players with the PATIENT token.
en.otherNightReminder: Remove all PATIENT tokens. The Physician points to two players not themselves. Mark both players with the PATIENT token. If a player with a PATIENT token was killed by the Demon, place the 1ST DEMON token next to the Physician and wake the Physician and show them Demon token.

zh.name: 医师
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择除你以外的两名玩家：他们今晚不会醉酒中毒且得知正确信息。如果他们当中首次有人被恶魔杀死，当晚你会得知恶魔类型。

revisions.v1: 每个夜晚，你要选择除你以外的两名玩家：他们今晚不会醉酒中毒且得知正确信息。如果他们当中首次有人被恶魔杀死，当晚你会得知恶魔类型。

zh.flavor: ‘有些病人康复了，因为他们信任医生。’-希波克拉底 前460-前370
zh.firstNightReminder: 唤醒医师，让他选择两名玩家。
zh.otherNightReminder: 唤醒医师，让他选择两名玩家。如果恶魔杀死被医师选择的玩家且医师角色标记旁没有“首次被恶魔杀死”标记，唤醒医师并向他展示恶魔角色标记。
